En la partida normal, el juego empieza f: In normal runs, the game starts easy and gets harder as you upgrade: more enemy health and damage, more enemies, more frequent hordes and more experience needed per level.
Dificultad adaptativa (solo partida norm: Adaptive difficulty (normal runs only): the game starts easy, especially if you use a new Pokémon with no permanent upgrades, and gets harder as you upgrade your Pokémon (moves, stats, level and permanent upgrades). It raises enemy and boss health and damage, spawn rate, horde frequency and the experience needed to level up. Shown under the clock as "Challenge" and can be turned off in Settings. If you struggle too much it eases off a little. Coins and records are unaffected.
